value.rationale: PASS: The problem of how a p-numerical gap set changes immediately beyond the sharp classical p-Apery range is a concrete structural research question. The first three levels remain an interval plus h isolated gaps, while the fourth undergoes a new long-block transition and isolated count drops to h-1 uniformly in the unbounded even base. An exact gap-set classification simultaneously yields an unreported genus and gap sum. This is not a mere tiny numerical increment or a restatement of the known maximum.
